intro: We list {{count}} MBA / PGDM colleges in Punjab where our records show a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh: IIM Amritsar and the Mohali campus of the Indian School of Business.

These MBA colleges in Punjab with ₹50 lakh highest package are very different from each other. IIM Amritsar is a public two-year MBA, while ISB Mohali offers a post-graduate programme with a much higher fee in our records.
listLead: ISB is often thought of as a Hyderabad school; the campus on this Punjab list is Mohali. Confirm which campus, which programme and which placement year you are reading.
snapshot: IIM Amritsar is 64th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. Its 2024 MBA row in our file shows an average of ₹20 LPA and a highest of ₹59 LPA.

ISB Mohali's PGP row for 2022 shows an average of ₹34 LPA and a highest of ₹72 LPA in our records, with a recorded total fee of ₹38.67 lakh, matching the official 2026–27 shared-accommodation grand total including GST. That placement year should be checked against a newer official report.
firstCollegesLead: The two colleges on this short list are among the top MBA colleges in Punjab 2026 by this measure, but they do not share a fee band, an entrance test or a campus type. Compare them only after you line up those basics.

compare.heading: How to read highest-package figures in Punjab
paragraphs: A public IIM and ISB's Mohali campus are not substitutes. Look at fee, programme length, work-experience rules and the official report, not only the highest package.
bullets: IIM Amritsar's official NIRF 2025 Management rank is 64th; ISB does not appear in that top 100 list.
Our ISB fee record is ₹38.67 lakh for the official 2026–27 PGP shared-accommodation grand total, which is a different cost level from a public IIM.
The ISB placement year in our file is 2022, so prefer the latest official report.

faqs.question: Which MBA colleges in Punjab with ₹50 lakh highest package are listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} colleges: IIM Amritsar and ISB Mohali. IIM Amritsar's 2024 row shows a highest of ₹59 LPA, and ISB Mohali's 2022 PGP row shows a highest of ₹72 LPA, in our file.

faqs.question: What is IIM Amritsar's NIRF rank?
faqs.answer: IIM Amritsar is 64th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. Use that 2025 rank rather than any older number on a card.

faqs.question: Is ISB Mohali the same as ISB Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: They are campuses of the same school, but this Punjab page lists the Mohali campus. Confirm the campus, the PGP batch and the official placement report before you compare offers.

faqs.question: Are these packages guaranteed for 2026?
faqs.answer: No. They are historical records, and the ISB figure in our file is from 2022. Offers change with every batch, so use the latest official report.
